main_text.p: demum folerti confilio Agafifthenis praefentiffimo periculo funt erepti.Cum enim Diæus dedi fibi pofceret primores xxiiii, velut civitatis & publicæ quietis turbatores,fuafit ille & perfuafit iifdem, ut civitate fponte cederent, & Romam confugerent. Futurum namque dicebat, ut brevi per Romanos reducerentur. Quibus in exilium voluntarium profectis, & capitis à civitate damnatis, bellum tum fuit amotum. Mox legati ab utrifque Romam miffi, Menalcidas à Spartanis, Diæus & Callicrates ab Achæis, qui fuorum caufas apud fenatum tuerentur. Sed Callicrates Rhodum ex itinere deflectens illic finem vivendi fecit multò feliciorem quàm tot ejus confilia & facinora perniciofa, patriæque exitialia merebantur. Reliqui duo diu fœdè rixati inter fe in curiâ Romanâ hoc demum refponfum tulêre, miffurum fenatum legatos in Græciam, qui coràm rem omnem cognofcerent & componerent, fi poffent. Sed fraude Diæi & Menalcidæ factum, qui celeriter domum recurrerant, & falfa pro veris utrimque retulerant,dum [?]ardè[?] legati Romani iter facerent, ut ante horum adventum Achæi in arma rursum contra Spartanos ferrentur, novo prætore Damocrito post Diæum jam

page.notes: The scan is cut off at the left edge, so the start of the line "sardè" is partly lost; the reading "[?]ardè[?]" is doubtful. The reading of "xxiiii" is also doubtful. Faint text at the lower left, and the partly visible letters there, look like show-through or the neighbouring page and were not transcribed. The text reads as one paragraph with no indented line visible, and it continues from the previous page.
